decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct accounts of awards received by Hideo Kojima. Document 2 (D2S14, D2S18) explicitly states he received the 'Academy Fellowship Award' (also referred to as the BAFTA Fellowship Award). Document 1 (D1S16) describes a fictional scenario where he is conferred the title 'Knight of the Order of the Sword'. Both are valid answers based on the text provided, representing different sources (one factual/biographical, one narrative/fictional) within the input. Other candidates like 'BAFTA Fellowship' (C2) are synonymous with C0, 'Fellowship' (C3) is too generic, and 'Order of the Sword' (C5) or 'Knight' (C6) are partial references to the full title in C1. Locations and people mentioned are not awards.
